answers.rationale: Use rideshares: the short clinic distance, costly parking, reliable airport coverage, walkable dinner, and secure onsite demo-bag storage make a rental mostly idle. History shows transportation choices vary with storage and local logistics rather than a fixed city-clinic policy.

Reserve the compact: a 25-mile early-morning trip, two bins, thin rideshare coverage, and reserved free loading favor self-driving. The rental also costs less than two car-service legs. Prior choices are conditional on access, materials, and parking, not a standing rental rule.

Take the airport shuttle and use rideshare only for the optional dinner. An attached hotel, no equipment, frequent shuttle, and $49 nightly parking give a rental no operational benefit. Historical conference transport decisions depend on venue proximity and gear needs rather than a fixed urban-transport preference.
